Beacon Componentization Refactor · State Flow and Component Contract Freeze (Phase 0 closing delivery) ​

Basis: docs/design/redesign-plan-2026-10-16.md (external design draft) + docs/design/redesign-2026-10-16-核验.md (50-item current-state verification, 759742b) + docs/design/redesign-2026-10-16-映射与迁移.md (§6 pending-decision list, e1229fc). Time point: 2026-10-16. The PATROL1016 inspection ticket authorized 「可自主决策的直接拍板并写进仓内决策记录」 — this file is that decision record; irreversible or out-of-scope matters remain open questions (see §4). Nature: the state flow contract and the component contract are frozen as of this document; later phases (Phase 2-6) build without touching the public surface of this contract, and changing the contract requires a new decision entry.

1. Four concepts (State / Event / Command / Operation Result) ​

ConceptIn-repo locationSemantics
StateWidgetState (12-field characterization in Mapping & Migration §2.1) + IStateStore (snapshot surface)Normalized projection of external-system facts + derived state (IsStale/ConnectionHealthy); the single authoritative snapshot lives in the State Store
EventEvents/Events.cs six records: WidgetStateChanged ConnectionHealthChanged WidgetsInvalidated AggregateStatusChanged NotificationRaised ActionExecutedThe state stream's transport surface; subscribe and unsubscribe via IEventBus.Subscribe/Publish (the UI side marshals back to the UI thread via SubscribeOnUi, RFC §11)
CommandActionConfig.Type (7 Type strings) → ActionRunner → IActionExecutorThe single entry point for user intent; the targeted refresh after execution goes through RefreshScheduler.Kick (state flows back after an Action); no separate command bus is introduced
Operation ResultActionResult(ActionId, Success, Message, OutputPath, CompletedAt) (Models/ActionModels.cs:28)Current two states (bool Success); the target five states are in §4 已代决③

2. State flow contract (frozen) ​

  1. Publish point: the success path and the stale path of WidgetHost both publish uniformly via IStateStore.Update (since f5d1d91); the WidgetStateChanged event shape is unchanged and the UI notices nothing.
  2. IStateStore signature (Abstractions/IStateStore.cs, frozen as landed in f5d1d91): Update(WidgetState) / Get(widgetId) / Snapshot() / Invalidate(widgetIds).
  3. Change detection rule (Services/StateStore.cs content key): all fields except FetchedAt participate (length-prefixed segments guard against delimiter ambiguity; Payload is sorted by key, insertion-order independent); an IsStale / ConnectionHealthy flip always publishes (scenario F5: the offline-degradation event must not be swallowed by dedup, anchored by StateStoreTests.DedupOn_StaleFlip_Republishes).
  4. Dedup enabled by default (d71bdc8, 已代决②): a refresh-time-only change does not trigger downstream; the snapshot still keeps the latest FetchedAt.
  5. Invalidation: consumers of WidgetsInvalidated are responsible for dropping local residue; Invalidate is the matching Store-side cleanup surface (App-side wiring of the shared Store is handled together with the Phase 3 binding engine; the current UI goes through the event bus and is unaffected).

3. Component contract (frozen; the four compatibility items adopted as in Mapping & Migration §5) ​

  1. The six JSON file names and existing field semantics are unchanged (config / connections / widgets / pins / actions / notifications).
  2. The new component model enters as incremental optional fields on WidgetConfig; old files stay readable; no migration, no renaming. ConfigVersion only increments when migration semantics are actually needed — pure additive optional fields write no keys, so it stays untouched (⑤⑧⑨ each have unit test anchors); zero noise for existing config.
  3. The existing 23 widget type keys, 7 Action Type strings, and all window layers (L0-L3 + Settings) are preserved; componentization only replaces the rendering segment and the state entry point.
  4. The 71-item on-machine acceptance checklist and the CI visual-evidence scenarios remain in force; the phase counts as complete only after the full Phase 6 regression.
  5. Component descriptor shape and mounting surface (已代决⑤, src/Beacon.Core/Models/ComponentDescriptor.cs): ComponentDescriptor(Id, Type, Props, Children) → WidgetConfig.Components: Dictionary<string, ComponentDescriptor>? (open set of surface keys, current vocabulary tile / row / detail); nested composition is allowed with blast-proof caps (8 levels / 32 children / 256 nodes); structurally invalid = discard the whole tree back to traditional rendering + diagnostics, no silent pruning.
  6. Bindings and instances (已代决⑥, src/Beacon.Core/Models/ComponentBinding.cs + Services/WidgetInstanceResolver.cs): bindings enter the tree with their node (ComponentBinding(Field, Source)); sources have three kinds: state / selector / const; an instance = the surface-key resolution result, fail-closed (no surface tree / invalid tree → null → traditional rendering); instances and config are shared read-only, resolution does no IO.
  7. Binding engine (已代决⑦, src/Beacon.Core/Services/ComponentBindingEngine.cs): every bound node in the tree keys its Field value out as {node path}.{field} (same convention as the validation diagnostics); the source-name map reserves key "" = own state; any binding that cannot resolve a value returns an empty string (fail-closed) — no throwing, no guessing; selector sources hook up only Core's existing pure-function selectors.
  8. Data source aggregation (已代决⑧, WidgetConfig.Sources: Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string,string>>? surface key → source name → widgetId): source names match exactly and case-sensitively; the reserved key "" (the instance's own state) must not be used; ≤16 sources per surface; an illegal declaration discards the whole surface (all extra sources dropped, own state always available) + diagnostics into the load log; the runtime source map is built by WidgetInstanceResolver.ResolveSources from the state snapshot via widgetId lookup, sources that cannot be found are simply absent (the binding side returns an empty string); composition aggregates multiple WidgetIds at the component layer, and the WidgetState single-ConnectionId Provider convention is untouched.
  9. Shared consumption (已代决⑨, src/Beacon.Core/Services/ComponentSourceIndex.cs): one and the same state object can be consumed by any number of instances (resolution is a pure function, shared by reference, not copied); ConsumedWidgetIds(instance) gives the full set of widgetIds an instance needs (own Id first, extra sources in declaration order, duplicate widgetIds deduped), and SourcesOf(instances) reverse-maps widgetId → consuming instance set; the index is rebuilt on demand and never cached.
  10. Component-layer pure-function boundary (已代决⑩): ComponentTreeValidator / ComponentSourcesValidator / WidgetInstanceResolver / ComponentBindingEngine / ComponentSourceIndex are all static classes (no instance state, no cache surface); no public method takes runtime services (Provider / executors / Store / event bus / Clock, etc.) — state and config enter only as data parameters; the number of state lookups is decided solely by the source declarations and is independent of layout shape, and the engine does zero lookups during resolution. Changing layout = re-resolving against the same state snapshot, producing no data requests (doubly anchored by the construction and tests of Phase 3 row 6).

已代决⑤Component descriptor shape: ComponentDescriptor(Id?, Type, Props:string→string, Children[]) mounted at WidgetConfig.Components: Dictionary<string,ComponentDescriptor>? (open set of surface keys, current tile/row/detail vocabulary); nested composition is allowed, with blast-proof caps of 8 levels / 32 children / 256 nodes; structurally invalid discards the whole tree back to traditional rendering + diagnosticsThe user authorized deciding the descriptor shape on 2026-10-16 (FW1016D). §3.2 already framed "incremental optional fields"; this item fixes only the shape: ① an open set of surface keys rather than a single root — the same widget takes different forms at L0 tile / L2 row / L3 detail, and a single-root tree would force all three layers into one shape; ② Props are all strings — same convention as WidgetConfig.Config/ActionConfig.Parameters, hand-written JSON cannot produce type ambiguity, and type conversion stays at render time; ③ allowing nesting is the very reason descriptors exist (Surface.Card wraps Text, StatusCard wraps indicator + title; as-built §2 already composes this way), but unbounded nesting would amplify one hand-typo into a recursive stack overflow — hence the caps and whole-tree discard when invalid (no silent pruning into half a tree, no crash of the resident process); ④ the registry of component type keys and the unknown-key policy are left to Phase 3 row 3 binding dispatch (the registry lives on the render side and is not preset here); ⑤ no migration semantics, so ConfigVersion stays untouched (optional fields write no keys, existing widgets.json is readable with zero noise, anchored by unit tests)In effect
已代决⑥Binding declarations enter the tree with their node (ComponentBinding(Field, Source) mounted at ComponentDescriptor.Bindings); binding sources have three kinds state/selector/const (the state path is closed over the supported field set + payload:key); extra data sources go through SourceName (mapping in ⑧); instance resolution is fail-closed (no surface tree / invalid tree → null → traditional rendering); instances and config are shared read-onlyThe user authorized deciding the descriptor shape on 2026-10-16 (FW1016D); this item is the descriptor's binding surface. ① Entering the tree with the node rather than a widget-level binding table — a binding table would need its own node locators, i.e. describing the tree twice; ② the three source kinds cover all value-fetch scenarios (own state field / derived selector / static literal); a free-path DSL would make the error surface of hand-written JSON unbounded; ③ validation moves up front to load and resolution time — runtime never guesses bad paths (unknown kind and bad paths error out at resolution time and go into the diagnostics log); ④ instances do not copy the tree or Config, sharing read-only (same convention as the WidgetConfig.Config dictionary); changing layout only re-resolves, no IOIn effect
已代决⑦Binding engine = pure functions ComponentBindingEngine.Resolve(WidgetInstance, WidgetState) / Resolve(WidgetInstance, IReadOnlyDictionary<string,WidgetState>); bound values in the tree key out as {node path}.{field}; the source-name map reserves key "" = own state (the primary state), and extra source names are built from ⑧'s instance data source declarations; any unresolvable value returns an empty string; the selector source registry admits only Core's existing pure functions (value-hint = WidgetValueHint.Of, quota-windows = WidgetValueHint.MultiWindow)The user authorized deciding on 2026-10-16 (FW1016D); this item is the runtime executor of the descriptor's binding surface. ① Pure function, no IO, no Provider dependency is the constructive guarantee of the Phase 3 row 6 invariant — state is passed in by the caller as a snapshot, so changing layout only re-resolves and triggers no requests; ② path keys share one convention with the validation diagnostics (id or child{index}, joined by /), so the rendering segment and the diagnostics log can point at the same node — no second locator scheme; ③ unresolvable values return an empty string rather than throwing — in a resident process one bad hand-written JSON value must not blow up the whole panel; a missing value manifests as an empty string (row 3 validation already reports bad paths into the diagnostics at load/resolution time; runtime is only the last line of defense); ④ the selector registry admits no user-writable entries — new selectors go through Core code plus a registry entry, avoiding an arbitrary callable surface inside JSONIn effect
已代决⑧Multi-source composition: surface-level declaration WidgetConfig.Sources (surface key → source name → widgetId) as incremental optional fields; the runtime map is built by WidgetInstanceResolver.ResolveSources(instance, stateOf) from the state snapshot via widgetId lookup (unfindable sources are absent, the binding side returns an empty string); source names match exactly and case-sensitively; the reserved key "" = the instance's own state and must not be used by extra declarations; ≤16 sources per surface; an illegal declaration discards the whole surface (all extra sources dropped, own state always available) + diagnostics into the load logThe user authorized deciding on 2026-10-16 (FW1016D). Mapping & Migration §3.3 already framed "composition happens at the component layer aggregating multiple WidgetIds, and the WidgetState single-ConnectionId Provider convention is not broken"; this item lands the implementation surface: ① the declaration sits at surface level, not node level — data source aggregation is an instance property, at the same level as Components under the same surface-key convention, not attached again on tree nodes (nodes only write a SourceName reference); ② the reserved key "" carries own state and extra sources are named explicitly — the instance Id already is the self, and addressing it directly by widgetId would be redundant and unreadable in JSON ("runs"/"quota" are easier to write than a widgetId); ③ exact source-name matching, no case folding — source names are identifiers the user hard-writes; silently tolerating case is harder to debug than erroring; ④ an illegal declaration drops only that surface's extra sources, not the instance: extra sources are an additive capability and own state is always available; knocking the whole surface back to traditional rendering over one bad declaration is excessive punishment (only structural invalidity of the component tree discards the whole tree — the tree is the rendering skeleton, sources are not); ⑤ the 16-sources-per-surface cap belongs to the same hand-written JSON blast-radius family as Components' 8/32/256; ⑥ it does not move with ConfigVersion (optional fields write no keys, existing widgets.json is readable with zero migration, anchored by unit tests)In effect
已代决⑨Different components share one and the same state: resolution is a pure function that reads state read-only, shared by reference, not copied; ComponentSourceIndex.ConsumedWidgetIds(instance) = the full set of widgetIds an instance needs (own Id first, extra sources in declaration order, duplicate widgetIds deduped), ComponentSourceIndex.SourcesOf(instances) reverse-maps widgetId → consuming instance set; the index is a pure function, rebuilt on demand, never cachedThe user authorized deciding on 2026-10-16 (FW1016D). Design-draft acceptance 3 「同一份数据可以被不同类型的组件展示」 + acceptance 7 「数据变化只更新必要的消费者」; this item lands the reverse-queryable fact surface: ① shared by reference, not cloned — when one state is consumed by N surfaces there is only one copy in memory; the content equality of WidgetState (the dedup/event convention) only means something when state is shared; ② the index is needed in both directions — 「这份状态被谁消费」 is the routing surface for invalidation and updates (row 6), and 「这个组件要哪些源」 is the scoping surface for subscription and refresh (⑧'s source declarations); both derive from the same Sources declaration, so two conflicting conventions cannot arise; ③ own Id always enters the consumption set — when a binding's SourceName is empty it reads own state, and missing the registration would drop the self consumer from 「这份状态变了」; ④ the index is not cached — where to put a cache and when to invalidate it is exactly the source of 「无意义请求」 (what row 6 tackles head-on)In effect
已代决⑩Component-layer pure-function boundary (Phase 3 row 6): the five component-layer types (ComponentTreeValidator / ComponentSourcesValidator / WidgetInstanceResolver / ComponentBindingEngine / ComponentSourceIndex) are all static classes, and no public method takes runtime services (IConnectionProvider / IActionExecutor / IStateStore / IConfigurationStore / ICacheStore / ISecretStore / IEventBus / IClock / INotificationSink); state lookups = 1 for self + the number of Sources declarations, independent of layout shape; zero lookups once the engine holds the mapThe user authorized deciding on 2026-10-16 (FW1016D). Row 6 is a 「保证」 not a 「功能」; this item turns it into a regression-testable boundary: ① reflection guards the public signatures — the moment someone stuffs a Provider or Store into the component layer for 「顺手取数」, changing layout would quietly fire data requests and the test goes red immediately, caught earlier than review or comments; ② the lookup count guards behavior — from a 1-node layout to 200 levels of nesting, the state lookup count stays unchanged (2 = self + 1 extra source) and the engine does zero lookups during resolution, directly proving 「布局不驱动数据请求」; ③ static classes = no cache surface, so the question of 「什么时候失效」 cannot even arise — ⑨ already fixed the index as rebuilt on demand and never cached; this item generalizes that constraint to the whole component layer (where to put a cache and when to invalidate it is exactly the source of 「无意义请求」)In effect

5. Outstanding items ​

  • BeaconRuntime creates the shared StateStore and injects it into WidgetHost/the future binding engine (App-side wiring, Phase 3); for now the WidgetHost internal default Store is what takes effect.
  • Events.cs event count: Mapping & Migration §1.6 originally recorded 「5 个事件记录」 when the actual count is 6 (including ActionExecuted); corrected alongside this file.

6. Capability boundary, three tiers (P0-01, 2026-10-17) ​

The component contract says 「what can be written」; actual support is labeled in three tiers, per surface (tile / row / detail) below — do not mistake 「the contract allows it」 for 「it is accepted」; acceptance follows the on-machine checklist (§3.4's 71 items + the Phase 6 full regression):

TierScopetilerowdetail
Core model availableComponentDescriptor / tree validation / source validation / WidgetInstanceResolver / ComponentBindingEngine / ComponentSourceIndex (static pure functions, anchored by Core unit tests)✅✅✅
App wiredDeclarative rendering + binding reads + extra-source routing (PinTile / FloatingTile / QuickPanel rows / DetailWindow) + missing-source display✅✅✅
Real user scenario accepted71-item on-machine checklist + Phase 6 regression + sample runtime acceptance (docs/samples/declarative-vertical-sample.md "What to verify")⏳⏳⏳

Convention note: saving a component tree only persists to disk + re-registers (P3-02 split), fetching no data and publishing no re-render event — a surface renders with the new tree on the next state arrival; when no content change is suppressed by dedup, reopening the surface shows it. The settings-page save copy no longer claims 「正在重渲染」.
